# region top-left x40-110 y0-60, print as labels by color clusters
def dump(x0,x1,y0,y1):
  sub=a[y0:y1,x0:x1]
  # map colors to symbols by quantized
  q=(sub//48*48)
  uniq={}
  syms='0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnop'
  for y in range(sub.shape[0]):
    line=''
    for x in range(sub.shape[1]):
      key=tuple(q[y,x])
      if key not in uniq: uniq[key]=syms[len(uniq)%len(syms)]
      line+=uniq[key]
    print('%3d '%(y+y0)+line)
  for k,v in uniq.items(): print(v,k)
dump(48,100,2,30)
